body: I start a new AI job in 14 days and I've never used LangGraph. Learning it in public, every day.

I've built agents before with other tools. This team uses LangChain and LangGraph. So instead of panicking, a plan:
Week 1: fundamentals. Graphs, nodes, state.
Week 2: build one real agent end to end in Cursor, then break it on purpose.
Slide 5 is the exact prompt I'm using to make Claude my tutor. Save it.

Tools:
LangGraph: https://www.langchain.com/langgraph
LangChain: https://www.langchain.com

Claude: https://claude.ai
